issue_request: FHIR-2839 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Clinical Genomics change request for the former FamilyHistory resource. It asked to capture when family history was recorded because older family history is less reliable, and to add date as a search criterion.
initial_application: Historical commit 3e326be575070d4f2cf1c9fae1a1839cb30270f3 applied #2839 by adding FamilyHistory.date to the family history spreadsheet, adding a date search row for FamilyHistory.date, and adding a date value to the example. Later commit db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 refactored FamilyHistory into FamilyMemberHistory.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists familymemberhistory=FamilyMemberHistory as an active resource and records that FamilyHistory became FamilyMemberHistory. The current StructureDefinition and search-parameter bundle preserve the requested element and search parameter under the current FamilyMemberHistory name. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or later community decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because FamilyMemberHistory.date is already a 0..1 dateTime summary element and FamilyMemberHistory-date already searches FamilyMemberHistory.date.
